To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effect of social group identity is not uniform across countries.
the effect of social group membership on voting is very similar across the regions of Canada, Britain and the USA, and that this effect is much stronger than the effect on attitudes.
